card.name: Percent sign in saline fluid names
card.fires_on: The % after 0.45 in dextrose and sodium chloride fluid names, just before the word Sodium or Saline. Also the 'and' or '+' joining salt names in combined solutions.

modes.label: Percent in saline strength
modes.description: The % sign right after 0.45 in a dextrose and sodium chloride infusion name.
modes.example: 2.5% Dextrose and 0.45<<%>> Sodium Chloride Injection is a hypertonic

modes.label: Joining word in salt lists
modes.description: The 'and' or '+' that links the last ingredient in a multi-salt or dextrose-saline product name.
modes.example: potassium sulfate,<< and>> magnesium sulfate oral solution
